lang_code.description: ISO 639 language code to match for font substitution (e.g., 'si' for Sinhala).

default_family.description: Generic font family name to match when applying the substitution.

font_family.description: Name of the specific font to prepend as the primary choice.

hinting_enabled.description: Whether to append font hinting settings.

alias_target_family.description: The generic family name that the specific font is aliased to as a fallback.
